acceptance: the verdict is exactly one of the six predeclared labels, computed from the accounting identity and boundary comparisons with no rule chosen after seeing the numbers; the current-budget atlas exists
authority: owner 2026-09-19 assessment: measurement-first lineage with the quantities table, the accounting identity, six predeclared classifications, and the current-budget atlas as the critical artifact; no tonic, connectivity, weight or parameter changes. Authorized in manifests/todo.json as SCI-EI-RECRUITMENT-1

estimator.F-I: fresh single-cell curves per class from sealed results/battery_b1.json (0 to 40 current units, covering realized drives); rheobase is the lowest current with rate above 1 Hz
estimator.I_E_I_I_split: mean-field reconstruction: exact for time means by linearity of the sum over edges; instantaneous splits assume within-group homogeneity and are reported as approximation, never as verdict input
estimator.native_resolution: 1 ms bins, the established rate resolution of the retained series; group means, not per-neuron traces
estimator.rates: exact 1 ms-binned spike counts from the retained EI series, identical method to the EI diagnosis
estimator.residual_validity: the reconstructed mean split is accepted for DEFICIT and VETO classification only when its residual against the retained engine total satisfies |residual| <= 20 percent of |retained|; otherwise those readings are withheld as unreliable

principal_delta: none: measurement only. Static weights, counts, tonic and parameters read from a read-only rebuild of the sealed construction (no dynamics executed); currents, rates, v and u read from the retained EI series; F-I boundaries read from sealed curves
question: why do PV and VIP receive insufficient effective drive to cross their firing boundary while SST fires strongly
quantities: I_E to c(t) reconstructed mean-field from E-group rates and static weights
I_I to c(t) split by source class (PV, SST, VIP separately)
total I_syn(t) (retained engine current means; cross-checks the reconstructed split in the mean)
incoming edge count K_E to c (construction)
realized w_E to c distribution: mean, sum, count (construction)
isolated-cell F_c(I) around realized I_net (sealed F-I curves)
stop_condition: measurement only. One evaluation, then STOP; no tonic, connectivity, weight or parameter is changed and nothing is calibrated

verdicts.E_I_RECRUITMENT_DEFICIT: mean E excitation below 20 percent of the class tonic drive: structurally tiny supply, nothing to cancel
verdicts.INHIBITORY_VETO: mean E excitation at or above 20 percent of tonic but mean inhibitory magnitude exceeds it, with net drive below boundary
verdicts.INTRINSIC_EXCITABILITY_LIMIT: net drive at or above rheobase yet the class rate below 1 Hz
verdicts.STATE_DEPENDENT_RECRUITMENT_FAIL: net drive crosses rheobase transiently (max over time) but mean stays below it with rate below 1 Hz
verdicts.combination: per-class cause by the ordered tests DEFICIT, VETO, LIMIT, STATE; both classes same cause names it, different causes name MIXED, no cause names UNRESOLVED
verdicts.silent: class rate below 1 Hz over the full run

visualization_contract.reason: read-only analysis of sealed EI retention plus a read-only construction rebuild for static weights; no dynamics simulated
